Fantech X9 Thor Black Chroma RGB Gaming Mouse (4800 DPI Optical Sensor / 7 Programmable Buttons / Dynamic Chroma RGB Matrix / 10 Million Clicks Lifecycle / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Elevate your desktop aesthetics and tracking efficiency with the Fantech X9 Thor Black Chroma RGB Gaming Mouse, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. This premium Black Edition framework features an advanced high-speed optical gaming sensor engineered to deliver on-the-fly resolution adjustments scaling up to 4800 DPI. Outfitted with a vibrant, fully custom dynamic Chroma RGB illumination lighting matrix, it delivers breathtaking multi-mode running light effects across your battle station layout. Armed with 7 fully programmable action buttons, gamers can instantly script complex macros and customized profiling parameters via the intuitive software dashboard. Constructed with ultra-durable switches rated for a heavy-duty 10 million clicks lifecycle and finished in an ergonomic, sweat-resistant non-slip texture, this wired system offers absolute handling precision for intensive esports deployment.
